name: Gwyddno

attributes.attribute: A Welsh hero and a minor figure in the story of Kulhwch and Olwen.
He owned a basket that magic kept filled with food.
Kulhwch had to steal the basket to win Olwen.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwyddno Garanhir was a Welsh hero and a minor figure in the tale of Kulhwch and Olwen. He owned a basket that magic kept full of food at all times. Kulhwch had to steal that basket in order to win his beloved Olwen.

okr.objective: Summarize Gwyddno Garanhir as a Welsh hero defined by his magical basket in the Kulhwch and Olwen tale.
